Build Maps for Multiple Elements

Source: R/map.R
ls_map_elements.Rd

Build Maps for Multiple Elements

Usage

ls_map_elements(
  dataset,
  elements,
  lines_nm,
  calibrations = NULL,
  window_nm = 1
)

Arguments

dataset

A ls_dataset() object with spatial coordinates.

elements

Character vector. Elements to map.

lines_nm

Named numeric vector: wavelength per element (e.g. c(Ca = 393.37, Fe = 371.99)).

calibrations

Named list of ls_calibration() objects. Default NULL.

window_nm

Numeric. Integration window. Default 1.

Value

A named list of libs_map objects.

Examples

ds <- ls_example_data("spatial")
ls_map_elements(ds, c("Ca", "Fe"),
                c(Ca = 393.37, Fe = 371.99))
#> $Ca
#> <libs_map>
#> • Element: "Ca"
#> • Line: 393.37 nm
#> • Points: 400
#> • Range: 0-13 a.u.
#> • Grid: 20x20
#> 
#> $Fe
#> <libs_map>
#> • Element: "Fe"
#> • Line: 371.99 nm
#> • Points: 400
#> • Range: 0-5.43 a.u.
#> • Grid: 20x20
#>
